messages:
jessie: Heads-up — external assessment team is booked for Tue 4/14 09:00-13:00 UTC. Scope: RBAC changes, KMS integration for key wrapping, and audit log evidence. We need a dry run + short retest window.

sam: Got it. Do we want a dry-run a week before or two days before? dry-run helps catch ephemeral-role issues. :+1:

jessie: Propose dry-run Tues 4/7 10:00-11:30 UTC. Smaller scope: create ephemeral assessor role, rotate test key in KMS proxy, verify audit export to S3 and SIEM.

alinor: For SIEM mapping — what retention/export snapshot are we providing? Assessors want 30 days of authz/audit traces and user->role mapping.

maria: Confirming no PHI/PCI in test scope; product team will redline datasets. If any customer PIIs appear, we need an evidence sanitizer step.

qa-bot: Checklist snippet attached: 
- create ephemeral IAM role (15m TTL)
- grant read-only access to service logs and audit logs
- KMS test key in sandbox account w/ key policy allowing assessor envelope-decrypt only
- run ingest smoke test and export one-day window to presigned S3

sam: Can someone share the ephemeral role creation snippet? I can automate the TTL via the ops lambda.

jessie: Paste below — this is what we use for dry-run (adjust ARNs):
```
aws iam create-role --role-name assessor-ephemeral --assume-role-policy-document file://assume.json
# assume.json allows sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity for assessor OIDC
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name assessor-ephemeral --policy-name read-audit-logs --policy-document file://read-audit.json
# read-audit.json grants s3:GetObject for s3://redwood-pt-logs/* and logs:DescribeLogStreams for CloudWatch
```

alinor: Also add CloudTrail lookup events and ensure KMS GenerateDataKey calls are logged. We should enable key policy audit alias so we can show key usage during test.

maria: Who will own evidence packaging? Need someone to collect S3 presigned links + short README with query steps.

tyler: I can own packaging. Will produce a signed manifest and presigned links to a timeboxed bucket.

jessie: Thanks @tyler. Action list for dry-run (4/7):
- @sam: deploy ephemeral-role automation to staging and set TTL=15m
- @alinor: enable CloudTrail event selectors for KMS + CloudWatch logs export; verify SIEM ingestion
- @tyler: prepare evidence packaging template (manifest + README)
- @maria: scrub test dataset and confirm no customer data in evidence
- @jessie: coordinate assessor onboarding and presigned link handoff

sam: One more: we need a fallback plan if KMS proxy rotation fails. Suggest keeping a read-only model endpoint pinned to older key and note runbook steps to revoke access.

jessie: Agreed. Add a rollback corridor in runbook: 
1) revoke assessor role immediately
2) rotate proxy routing back to key-v1
3) preserve logs and escalate to sec-oncall if anomalies found

alinor: For retest window — assessors asked for 2-hour slot within 72 hours after remediation. Propose Wed 4/15 09:00-11:00 UTC as retest. Everyone ok?

maria: Works for product.

tyler: Works for ops. I’ll prep rapid evidence re-run scripts.

jessie: OK locking retest Wed 4/15 09:00-11:00 UTC. Final notes: keep TTLs short, record all assume-role events, and make the SIEM queries reproducible (add them to README).

sam: Will add a smoke script: `scripts/pt_smoke.sh` that performs assume-role -> list-logs -> decrypt-sample -> upload-presigned.

qa-bot: Dry-run reminder will post 24h before.

jessie: Thanks all — please ack when tasks are picked up. I’ll update the runbook in the security repo and link here. :white_check_mark:
